crossRefs.note: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but…
He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to…
The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.
until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and…
Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation…
saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;

translations.web: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
translations.bsb: “Have you also been deceived?” replied the Pharisees.
translations.kjv: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
translations.asv: The Pharisees therefore answered them, Are ye also led astray?
